title: Wildwood
overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

title: Paper Tiger
overview: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.

title: Focker In-Law
overview: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, aims to marry Olivia, a strong-willed former hostage negotiator who appears to be his complete mismatch. To Greg's shock, father-in-law Jack Byrnes takes a liking to Olivia, and her unprecedented rise into his Circle of Trust sparks chaos in the family before Jack's 80th birthday party.

title: Айтматов
overview: An upcoming biopic on world-renowned Kyrgyz author Chingiz Aitmatov. The film traces his childhood, losing his father, and the personal struggle that shaped his literary voice—from humble beginnings to becoming the voice of his nation.

title: Violent Night 2
overview: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

title: November 1963
overview: Prior to the election of John F. Kennedy in 1960, his father Joe Kennedy asked for a favor from mob boss Sam Giancana and the Chicago Outfit to ensure a win for the younger Kennedy. However, during the presidency, the national organized crime syndicate came under heavy fire from Attorney General Bobby Kennedy. The mob answered this perceived betrayal with the ultimate revenge: the assassination of the 35th President of the United States on November 22, 1963. The events are depicted through the perspective of Sam Giancana's brother, Pepe, who was present during the critical planning stages, detailing the intricate circumstances and the mob's direct involvement in setting up the assassination.

title: Hexed
overview: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

title: Dune: Part Three
overview: Nearly two decades after he seized control of the Imperium, Paul Atreides is now a ruthless Emperor, and must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

title: DreamQuil
overview: In a near future where poor air quality forces people into virtual lives, a dissatisfied mother joins a digital wellness retreat, only to return home and discover that a robotic replacement has taken her place, leading to a sinister mystery.

title: A Talent for Murder
overview: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

title: The Debut
overview: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.

title: Три богатыря и гуси-лебеди
overview: The swan-geese have snatched the children right from under the noses of their brave fathers: Ilya, Dobrynya, and Alyosha. There's nothing else to do but set out on a quest along rivers of milk and jelly, fending off various fairytale villains along the way, not with hands and feet, but more with your head. Resourcefulness is key in fighting geese, swans, and more important birds, like Koschey and Baba Yaga.

title: Jumanji: Open World
overview: Our heroes have escaped the ever-changing jungles of Jumanji before, but this time the game comes to us—as Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.

title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
overview: Red faces his greatest challenge yet—surviving fatherhood… while saving the world.

title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
overview: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.
